message.content: {"note_claim": "Caustic soda reacts violently with water, causing the solution to boil, splatter, or even explode, and can cause severe burns to the skin.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Caustic soda is exothermic when it is combined with water or acids, giving off a tremendous amount of heat. When the reaction is not properly controlled, it will make the solution boil, splatter, or even explode, giving rise to extreme burn hazards and possible property damage.", "reason": "The page directly confirms that caustic soda reacts exothermically with water and can cause boiling, splattering, explosion, and burn hazards, matching the note's claim."}

parsed.note_claim: Caustic soda reacts violently with water, causing the solution to boil, splatter, or even explode, and can cause severe burns to the skin.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Caustic soda is exothermic when it is combined with water or acids, giving off a tremendous amount of heat. When the reaction is not properly controlled, it will make the solution boil, splatter, or even explode, giving rise to extreme burn hazards and possible property damage.
parsed.reason: The page directly confirms that caustic soda reacts exothermically with water and can cause boiling, splattering, explosion, and burn hazards, matching the note's claim.
